docs.title: SQLite in WAL mode on a read-only mount
docs.body:
# SQLite in WAL mode on a read-only mount

A reader cannot create the `-shm` file on a read-only mount. Open the file with `immutable=1`. An immutable reader does not see changes that are still in the WAL file.

# Backups
